title: Knowledge Check 3: Lessons 11–15
description: Fifteen questions pooled from Lessons 11–15: FlexCards. Pass with 80% or higher to move toward unlocking the cert prep exam.

questions.question: Which mechanism passes data from a host Lightning page INTO a FlexCard?
questions.explanation: Public attributes (and session variables) expose entry points for host context.

questions.question: How does a card react to changes elsewhere on the page?
questions.explanation: Event listeners subscribe to events and trigger card reactions.

questions.question: Which advanced integration lets you nest one card inside another?
questions.explanation: Child FlexCards nest inside parent cards for composed displays.

questions.question: How do you apply consistent branding across many FlexCards at once?
options: A shared theme applied to the cards
questions.explanation: Themes centralize appearance; inline styles are per-element exceptions.

questions.question: Which takes precedence when both exist?
What is a benefit of themes over inline styling?
options: One change restyles all components using the theme
questions.explanation: Themes give centralized, consistent appearance with single-point changes.

questions.question: A card must show 'No records found' when the data source returns nothing. What do you use?
options: An empty state with a condition on record count
questions.explanation: States enable conditional rendering. Empty state triggers on zero records.

questions.question: A field should turn red when its value exceeds a threshold. Which mechanism?
questions.explanation: Conditional rendering can alter element appearance based on conditions.

questions.question: A custom state never displays even though data looks right. Likely cause?
options: The condition doesn't match the actual data (path/type)
The card has no data source
The page is in a Community
questions.explanation: Conditions must evaluate true against live data. Mismatches block the state.

questions.question: Which statement about embedding FlexCards is TRUE?
options: They only run on desktop Lightning pages
They embed across Lightning, Experience Cloud, OmniScripts, and mobile
questions.explanation: FlexCards are channel-agnostic: Lightning, Experience Cloud, OmniScript, mobile.

questions.question: What makes the same FlexCard work on both an internal console and a customer portal?
options: Public attributes for context + per-channel verification
questions.explanation: Public attributes make cards context-driven and reusable across channels.

questions.question: What does a FlexCard auto-generate for App Builder / Experience Builder embedding?
questions.explanation: FlexCards generate LWC wrappers for drag-and-drop embedding.

questions.question: Which is a documented FlexCard best practice?
options: Validate JSON, keep data sources lean, test all states
questions.explanation: Best practices: validated JSON, lean sources, caching, state/channel testing.

questions.question: When does a Data Mapper data source beat SOQL in a FlexCard?
options: When field-level security or transformation is needed
questions.explanation: Data Mappers respect FLS and transform data; SOQL is simpler but insecure for restricted users.

questions.question: How should complex multi-source data reach a FlexCard?
options: Via an Integration Procedure in one call
questions.explanation: IPs consolidate orchestration into one server call. The recommended pattern for complex data.
